 Metro Bus to Offer Free Rides for Voters on Election Day
 Saint Cloud, MN, USA / KNSI 
 Jennifer Lewerenz 
 Oct 19, 2026 | 9:29 AM 
 St. Cloud Metro Bus X 
 (KNSI) — St. Cloud Metro Bus is offering free rides to voters on Election Day and to veterans and active military members on Veterans Day.
 On Tuesday, November 3rd, anyone in the Metro Bus service area who is headed to or from a polling place can ride for free. Fixed Route riders need to tell the bus operator they are going to vote. Dial-a-Ride customers need to let the dispatcher know when they call to schedule their ride.
 On Wednesday, November 11th, all veterans and active military members can ride free on all Metro Bus services. Fixed Route riders must show a military ID when boarding. Dial-a-Ride customers need to notify Metro Bus of their veteran or active military status when scheduling, and be ready to show ID when they board. Service-connected veterans also ride Fixed Route buses for free every day with proper identification.
 Learn more by clicking here or by calling 320-251-1499.
